Meanwhile Arsenal sold Leandro Trossard to Besiktas and walked away from £117m Morgan Rogers (to Chelsea), but completed Belgian Pro League POTY forward Christos Tzolis (£34m, July 23) and are actively bidding £70m for Bruno Guimaraes while retaining Mikel Arteta's title-winning continuity. Keeping Arsenal's edge modest at 54/46 given Saliba's absence, World Cup fatigue for England regulars (Saka, Rice), City's 2026 H2H wins, and straight-to-penalties variance (with Donnarumma in goal).

questions.title: Who will be appointed to succeed Pape Thiaw as head coach of Senegal's men's national football team by August 31, 2026?
questions.background: The Senegalese Football Federation is responsible for appointing the national team's head coach.

Respecting the <=0.55 anti-overconfidence cap on unconfirmed appointments, raise Patrick Vieira 0.42 -> 0.53. Raise Omar Daf sharply 0.12 -> 0.20 as the sole remaining shortlist rival (L'Observateur deems his exit from Congo's assistant role legally possible and credible). Add Souleymane Diallo at 0.08 (explicitly named by Afrik-Foot Aug 4 as FSF's interim backup if Thiaw's severance dispute persists toward September AFCON qualifiers). Hold Habib Beye at 0.07 (free agent since July 1 Marseille exit; top candidate if FSF replaces Renard on the shortlist) and Malick Daf at 0.02 (internal FSF fallback), leaving 10% residual for surprise/replacement candidates.

questions.title: Who will President Donald Trump nominate in 2026 to succeed Marty Makary as FDA commissioner?
questions.background: Marty Makary resigned as commissioner of the US Food and Drug Administration in May 2026, leaving the position vacant. The president nominates the commissioner, subject to Senate confirmation.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official presidential announcement or reliable news reporting directly quoting that announcement. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the first person President Trump publicly announces as his nominee for FDA commissioner after Makary’s May 2026 resignation and before the end of 2026. The nomination announcement is sufficient; Senate confirmation is not required. Accepted Answer Format : The nominee’s full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Major shortlist overhaul based on Axios (June 26) and PharmaVoice (July 22): President Trump has still not announced a nominee to succeed Marty Makary as of July 22, and the White House has been actively vetting three reported finalists (Axios/Bloomberg): Pentagon principal deputy assistant secretary for health affairs Stephen Ferrara (former Navy and CIA CMO, whom Axios reports sources are 'generally most enthusiastic about' — new frontrunner at 0.20), White House Domestic Policy Council deputy director Dr. Heidi Overton (vetted finalist per Bloomberg/Axios and still explicitly floated in July 22 PharmaVoice, though facing industry/FDA staff pushback as a Makary protege — 0.17), and New York oncologist/CEO Jeffrey Vacirca (0.11). Acting Commissioner Kyle Diamantas (was 0.28) drops to 0.08 because he was omitted from the vetted finalist trio and PharmaVoice frames the search as naming a nominee to replace him, though his stability and Trump Jr./RFK Jr. ties keep a residual chance. Former Trump 1.0 FDA Commissioner Dr. Stephen Hahn enters at 0.06 after being floated by PharmaVoice on July 22 as a Senate-confirmable reassuring option amid a tight pre-midterm Senate calendar. A conservative 38% remains outside the top five for Brett Giroir, other administration/outside physicians, or an unannounced dark horse given four weeks without an announcement since the June 26 finalist report.
